# foreman_autosign (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_smartproxy" "puppet" {
  name = "puppet.example.com"
}

resource "foreman_autosign" "app_wildcard" {
  smart_proxy_id = data.foreman_smartproxy.puppet.id
  id             = "*.app.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The hostname or wildcard pattern to allow autosigning for (e.g. "host.example.com" or "*.example.com"). Foreman does not assign autosign entries a separate numeric id, so this value is both the input and the id.
- `smart_proxy_id` (Number) ID of the smart proxy this autosign entry applies to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import foreman_autosign.app_wildcard <smart_proxy_id>/<pattern>
```
